evangelism.how: Submit one online Evangelistic Request Form per church event, through the subsidy form at paconference.org/evangelism/subsidy (pastor logs in with the conference e-mail account), with the church board’s support by 30 September; the Evangelism Committee notifies the pastor.
conditions: Part of an intentional plan that includes pre-work and reaping; follow-up and disciple-making must also be prioritised.
Request up to but not exceeding 50% of the total cost; local church support and meeting offerings make up the other 50%.
Do not commit to budgeted expenditures until approval is received.
Up to 75% may be drawn three months before the meetings open (earlier for auditorium deposits); the rest after the Evangelistic Report Form.
Meetings under $1,000: pay the bills first, then claim reimbursement.
Claims must be made within the budget year; none after 31 December.
Funds only for the approved project; anything above the conference share of actual cost is returned.
The local treasurer keeps the budget in a ledger account separate from other church funds, with a receipt or voucher for each entry.
evangelism.report: Evangelistic Report Form, submitted immediately after the end of the meetings (releases the remaining funds and clears the advance).
